text:
maria (docs): Drafting the 'What's New' compact snippet for the upcoming deploy. Dropped a first pass in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 :eyes:
kevin (eng): saw it, quick callout — the streaming example still references `max_tokens` which we removed. Should use `max_new_tokens` now.
tess (docs): good catch. I'll update the snippet. Also propose we add a one-line customer note about the routing change (fallback for region mismatch) — could avoid a support spike.
ryan (sdk): SDK examples need a tiny tweak too. Node snippet should use the new `stream()` helper instead of the old callback pattern. I can push a commit.
maria (docs): can you add the code block inline and tag me? I'll run the preview smoke tests on staging.
ryan (sdk): pushed fix at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/abc123 — Node snippet now `client.generate(...).stream()` and uses `max_new_tokens`. :thumbsup:
kevin (eng): logging a known issue we should include: embeddings service sometimes returns 503 during model spinup for large models. Add to known-issues with repro steps and the recommended workaround (retry with exponential backoff).
tess (docs): added a bullet in the draft under "Known issues" with repro steps and the backoff workaround. Also linked to internal incident ticket #2347 for triage context.
maria (docs): small public-docs note — avoid linking internal incident pages. Use the customer-facing summary and link to the migration guide instead: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate-prefix-cache
kevin (eng): updated the known-issue wording to be customer-safe, removed internal link.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #512 — preview site generated at https://deploy-preview-512--docs.redwood.ai :rocket:
maria (docs): preview looks good on mobile, but the long SDK code block wraps awkwardly. Add a language hint so it renders correctly (```javascript). Also shorten some long lines.
ryan (sdk): will add the language hint and wrap lines at ~80 chars; pushing shortly.
tess (docs): link-checker flagged two stale links in the new banner copy. Fixed one; created follow-up task docs: broken-link-549 for the other (needs owner).
maria (docs): plan: merge PR once ryan's formatting commit lands, then publish the "What's New" banner. I'll assign the publish step to @tess and schedule for the next publish window. :calendar:
kevin (eng): sounds good — thanks everyone.
notes: This thread coordinates final QA for a compact 'What's New' entry, SDK snippet updates, and the addition of a customer-facing known-issues entry. Contains PR and preview links and an automated CI bot message.
